value.rationale: Computes the full conditional radial crossing law for a natural positive-probability high-dimensional geometric event. Gives a sharp annular central void but a positive limiting squared-radius variance, despite concentration of the corresponding chord lengths at sqrt(2). Separates random endpoint lines from generally inequivalent invariant-line sampling and can inform high-dimensional stereology.
